items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: The interviewee (Al Rose) narrates the relationship between Louis Armstrong and Oliver ('Louis, uh, went to work in the same band as Oliver... they played together in the band'). The interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with Oliver, only knowledge of this historical connection.

ctx.x: Yeah, see that's what I'm saying. He probably didn't have a clear picture as to know exactly, or the name of somebody. Right. Yeah. Uh, yeah, what, how much influence would like his playing in brass bands had on his, on his playing?

Well, he played in the Waif's brass band. Uh-huh. And, uh, he had kind of the responsibility of playing lead horn in that. Uh-huh. And, uh, I'm sure that he felt puffed up about that. Uh, you think so? Yeah. But, uh, he began to attract the attention of a lot of people around here. Uh-huh. And they recognized him particularly. Uh-huh. And then he played in the, in the band with Oliver, the, uh, what was it, Tuxedo, or the Honored, yeah. Yeah. And, uh, got familiar with him there. Uh-huh. But I'm sure that he…
How do you, how do you mean?
